text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornInCity(x, y) ::: x is born in city y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by person y.
Writer(x) ::: x is a writer.
Creates(x, y) ::: x creates y.
Title(x, y) ::: x is titled y.
PublishedIn(x, y) ::: x is published in year y.
Premises:
¬Podcast(x) ⊕ Novel(x) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornInCity(x, americancity) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
∀x (Book(x) ∧ Novel(x) ∧ WrittenBy(y, x) → Writer(y)) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(daniShapiro) ∧ Writer(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
Book(familyHistory) ∧ WrittenBy(daniShapiro, familyHistory) ∧ Novel(familyHistory) ∧ PublishedIn(familyHistory, year2003) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003 by Dani Shapiro.
Creates(daniShapiro, familySecrets) ∧ Title(familySecrets, familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
American(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
Writer(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is a novel writer.
